# Arulnidhi Karunanidhi

> Research Engineer — AI Evaluations & Agentic Safety.

## Research identity

Arulnidhi designs empirical evaluations for agentic AI systems and studies behavioural measurement, adversarial failure modes, memory integrity, and evaluation robustness.

His work follows a practical research trajectory:

**systems engineering → agent memory → adversarial benchmarking → evaluation methodology → agentic AI safety**

The objective is to make claims about agent behaviour testable and appropriately bounded: define the construct, establish meaningful baselines, expose systems to controlled and adversarial conditions, repeat trials, measure sensitivity, and document where results stop generalising.

## Research themes

- **Behavioural measurement:** valid, reproducible measures for stateful and multi-agent systems.
- **Adversarial failure modes:** systematic tests for contamination, trust-boundary violations, deceptive or unstable behaviour, and tool-use failures.
- **Memory integrity:** attribution, isolation, retrieval, provenance, and the downstream behavioural effects of corrupted or missing memory.
- **Evaluation robustness:** sensitivity to task construction, prompts, judges, models, context policies, baselines, and repeated runs.
- **Agentic AI safety:** using empirical evaluation to characterise capabilities, limitations, and safety-relevant failure modes.

## Background and provenance

Arulnidhi's foundation is more than a decade in data engineering and business intelligence, followed by work on persistent memory for multi-agent systems. This systems background informs an emphasis on reliability, observability, lineage, and failure analysis.

- [Aegis Memory](https://github.com/quantifylabs/aegis-memory) is the principal engineering artefact behind the memory-integrity work. It implements persistent, scope-aware memory for multi-agent AI systems.
- [Quantify Labs Ltd.](https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/16027803) is the UK-registered organisation through which Aegis was developed.
- MSc Big Data Analytics, Sheffield Hallam University.

Quantify Labs and Aegis are supporting provenance for the research programme; the primary identity is AI evaluation and agentic safety research engineering.

## Writing

The site covers evaluation design, behavioural measurement, adversarial benchmarks, agent memory integrity, multi-agent validation, and robustness analysis. Posts prioritise experimental design, measurable outcomes, limitations, and reproducibility.

- [Evaluating the Evaluator: What a Broken Scorer Taught Me About LLM Evals](https://arulnidhii.github.io/posts/evaluating-the-evaluator/) — a small learning experiment about deterministic, model-graded, and lexical evaluation methods, including scorer failure analysis and follow-up experiments.
